items.title: Copy-Paste Language Models
items.summary: Transformers are intuitively considered to be efficient at copying from their inputs. We actually show that the ability of LLMs to copy in context can be improved through explicit modeling. We propose Copy-Paste Language Models (CPLMs), which add a lightweight Copy-Paste head to the conventional language modeling (LM) head. CPLMs improve training efficiency, downstream performance, and offer new operating points in long-context and retrieval setups. We validate our approach by pretraining models
items.summary_zh: CPLM 在语言模型头部加入轻量复制粘贴头，显著提升上下文复制能力及训练效率。
items.why_zh: 提供显式建模复制行为的方法，可用于提升LLM在代码生成、摘录任务中的忠实度。

items.title: LEASH: Uncertainty-Aware Weak-to-Strong Escalation and Oversight for Computer-Use Agents
items.summary: Computer-use agents increasingly tackle long-horizon tasks, where running a frontier model at every step is expensive and a small open-weight model alone often fails. Weak-to-strong escalation offers a middle ground where a weak agent acts by default and hands control to a strong one only when needed. The core challenge is deciding when to escalate, which requires an uncertainty signal cheap enough to check at every step. However, even after handoff, the strong agent can still get lost, but a bl
items.summary_zh: 提出基于不确定性的弱到强模型切换机制，降低计算成本同时保持性能。
items.why_zh: 了解不确定性驱动的模型路由技术，可用于资源受限的 Agent 设计。

items.title: Using GPT to Judge GPT Is a Mistake, Here's Why
items.summary: If your agent runs on GPT and your eval judge also runs on GPT, you may be measuring agreement, not quality. Unify CTO Connor Heggie explains why an LLM judge needs to come from a different model family than the agent it's grading, and why he wants that relationship almost adversarial. Full episode of Max Agency, LangChain's podcast on building production agents. #AIagents #LLMasJudge #Evals #Unify #LangChain #MaxAgency
items.summary_zh: 指出用同家族 GPT 评估自身会测量一致而非质量，需用不同模型族作判断。
items.why_zh: 掌握评估偏差的根源，学会构建对抗式、跨模型评估体系，提升 Agent 性能测试可靠性。

items.title: Google Open-Sources Harness2, a Recursive Agent Harnessing Framework
items.summary: Google Research released Harness2, an Apache-2.0 framework that rewrites an agent's harness at test time. One refinement step lifted GLM-5 by 11.5 points on WorkBuddy-Bench with no weight updates. The post Google Open-Sources Harness2, a Recursive Agent Harnessing Framework appeared first on MarkTechPost .
items.summary_zh: Google 开源 Harness2，可在测试时重写 Agent harness，无需更新权重即提升性能。
items.why_zh: 了解递归 harness 技术，学会在运行时动态优化 Agent 行为，可复用于性能提升而不微调。

items.title: Meet Kyutai REKI: The 2.4B VLA Model Bringing Efficient Memory to Robot Manipulation
items.summary: Kyutai, with Inria and École des Ponts, has released REKI, a 2.4B vision-language-action model (VLA) for robot manipulation. The REKI vision-language-action model is pretrained only on public data. It also carries a cheap memory of its recent past. On three out-of-distribution benchmarks, only models about twice its size beat it. All weights are live on […] The post Meet Kyutai REKI: The 2.4B VLA Model Bringing Efficient Memory to Robot Manipulation appeared first on MarkTechPost .
items.summary_zh: Kyutai 发布 2.4B 参数 VLA 模型 REKI，具备廉价近期记忆，机器人操作表现接近两倍大模型。
items.why_zh: 学习如何在 VLA 中加入轻量记忆机制，实现高效机器人控制，可迁移到其他视觉语言动作任务。
